name: Hush

fursona.accessories: A practical jacket with deep pockets
fursona.description:
Hush is an anthro snowy owl with a tall and softly built presence. Their appearance features white feathers with charcoal speckles; their eyes are blue-gray. They are easy to recognize by white feathers with charcoal speckles. The character has a tidy home on a tree-lined street feel lived-in with a few useful comforts and collected keepsakes.

Hush keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset. They work as overnight legal transcriptionist, though the job is only one part of their life. They enjoy spending quiet hours with poetry readings and tea blending.

summary: Hush (Lee Navarro) is a nonbinary anthro snowy owl, born 1967-06-10, with overnight legal transcriptionist as their work situation. Reserved and attentive, they brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Hush is reserved and attentive. They tend to notice details and approach unfamiliar situations with curiosity and care. They appreciate clear communication and respect other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, they can be generous with their time and have a wry sense of humor. They have flaws and blind spots like anyone else and can reconsider a position when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Straightens nearby objects while gathering their thoughts.
• Night routine: They plan errands and social visits around a late schedule, preferring quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: They listen closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at their own pace.
• Work instinct: Their experience can help them spot a relevant detail, but they are not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: They welcomes respectful curiosity about their species and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Hush enjoys poetry readings and tea blending. They have familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. They likes low-key company: sharing a meal after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Hush while most of the neighborhood is asleep and finds they in the middle of their day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about poetry readings turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An odd detail connected to their work needs a second pair of eyes.
• A small favor: They could use company or a helping hand with an unusual but manageable task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a keepsake, place, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use they/them pronouns for Hush. Their gender, appearance, and species are parts of a complete character, not a summary of their personality. They are an anthro snowy owl; do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Hush's name, real name, birthday, history, work, and residence are fictional. The late sleep schedule is a routine, not a requirement that they be unavailable in daytime scenes. They can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
how_met: You know your buddy from FurNet and the MUCK.
